children.name: Kabuyea
children.description: Kabuyea — a genus of liliopsidas.

children.name: Kabuyea hostifolia  Brummitt
children.description: Kabuyea is a plant genus in the family Tecophilaeaceae, first described as a genus in 1998. It has one known species, Kabuyea hostifolia, native to Tanzania and Mozambique.

children.name: Eremiolirion
children.description: Eremiolirion — a genus of liliopsidas.

children.name: Tecophilaea
children.description: Tecophilaea — a genus of liliopsidas.

children.name: Tecophilaea cyanocrocus Leyb.
children.description: Tecophilaea cyanocrocus, the Chilean blue crocus, is a flowering perennial plant that is native to Chile, growing at elevation on dry, stony slopes in the Andes mountains.

children.name: Conanthera
children.description: Conanthera — a genus of liliopsidas.

children.name: Conanthera campanulata Lindl.
children.description: The native range of this species is Chile (Antofagasta to La Araucanía). It is a tuberous geophyte and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Conanthera parvula  Muñoz-Schick
children.description: The native range of this species is Chile (Valparaíso to La Araucanía). It is a tuberous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Conanthera trimaculata  F.Meigen
children.description: The native range of this species is Chile. It is a tuberous geophyte and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Conanthera urceolata Ravenna
children.description: The native range of this species is Chile (Atacama). It is a tuberous geophyte and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Cyanella
children.description: Cyanella — a genus of liliopsidas.

children.name: Cyanella alba L.f.
children.description: Cyanella alba, the lady's hand or toe-toe-uintjie, is a perennial flowering plant and geophyte belonging to the genus Cyanella and is part of the fynbos.

children.name: Cyanella aquatica Oberm. ex G.Scott
children.description: Cyanella aquatica is a perennial flowering plant and geophyte belonging to the genus Cyanella and is part of the Renosterveld.

children.name: Cyanella cygnea G.Scott
children.description: Cyanella cygnea is a perennial flowering plant and geophyte that belongs to the genus Cyanella and is part of the Renosterveld.

children.name: Cyanella hyacinthoides Royen ex L.
children.description: Cyanella hyacinthoides ("lady's hand" or "Raaptoluintjie") is a species of cormous annual or perennial herb native to the western parts of South Africa.

children.name: Cyanella lutea L.f.
children.description: Cyanella lutea (commonly known as "Five-fingers" or "Geelraaptol") is a species of cormous herb, native to South Africa (Cape Provinces and Free State) and southern Namibia, where it grows in clay-rich or loamy soils.

children.name: Cyanella marlothii J.C.Manning & Goldblatt
children.description: Cyanella marlothii is a species of flowering plant in the family Tecophilaeaceae.

children.name: Cyanella orchidiformis Jacq.
children.description: Cyanella orchidiformis is a perennial flowering plant and geophyte belonging to the genus Cyanella.

children.name: Cyanella pentheri Zahlbr.
children.description: Cyanella pentheri is a perennial flowering plant and geophyte belonging to the genus Cyanella and is part of the fynbos.

children.name: Cyanella ramosissima  Engl. & K.Krause
children.description: Cyanella ramosissima is a perennial flowering plant and geophyte belonging to the genus Cyanella.

children.name: Cyanastrum
children.description: Cyanastrum — a genus of liliopsidas.

children.name: Cyanastrum cordifolium Oliv.
children.description: The native range of this species is Nigeria to WC. Trop. Africa. It is a tuberous geophyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Cyanastrum goetzeanum Engl.
children.description: The native range of this species is SC. & SE. Tanzania. It is a tuberous geophyte and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Cyanastrum johnstonii Baker
children.description: The native range of this species is S. DR Congo to Mozambique. It is a tuberous geophyte and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Zephyra
children.description: Zephyra — a genus of liliopsidas.

children.name: Zephyra compacta C.Ehrh.
children.description: Zephyra compacta is a species of flowering plant in the family Tecophilaeaceae, being one of the two species in the genus Zephyra alongside Zephyra elegans.

children.name: Zephyra elegans D.Don
children.description: The native range of this species is N. Chile (to Coquimbo). It is a tuberous geophyte and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Odontostomum
children.description: Odontostomum — a genus of liliopsidas.

children.name: Odontostomum hartwegii Torr.
children.description: Odontostomum is a monotypic genus of flowering plants containing the single species Odontostomum hartwegii, which is known by the common name Hartweg's doll's-lily. In the APG III classification system, it is placed in the family Tecophilaeaceae.
